therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: antibody-drug conjugate targeting Nectin-4 with monomethyl auristatin E payload
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell cytotoxicity via microtubule disruption
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: safety and tolerability (dose escalation), objective response rate (expansion cohorts), pathological complete response rate (MIBC cohorts)

results.dose_information: IV infusion on days 1 and 8 every 21 days

context.comparator: various combinations with pembrolizumab, cisplatin, carboplatin, gemcitabine
context.investigator_commentary: Sponsor stopped the study after meeting enrollment targets and primary objectives, and after collecting sufficient data for planned regulatory filings. The decision was not due to safety concerns, futility, or any regulatory request.
